name: ipcch-ch-gate-ablation
title: IPCCH CH-heterogeneity and split-gate ablation
description: Rerun the IPCCH GeoRF baseline as a cohort x gate factorial: cohort in {all, non-CH, CH-only} by split gate in {0.01, 0.005}. Tests whether the Cadre Harmonise areas (admin_code >= 100000) are too heterogeneous to pool with IPC areas, and whether the strict class-1 F1 split gate is what suppressed partition learning. Reuses IPCCHGeoRFExperiment unchanged apart from the cohort filter and the gate override.
creator: swl007007
notes: Six-cell factorial complete. Neither the 0.01 split gate nor CH heterogeneity explains the IPCCH failure to beat persistence: relaxing the gate produces splits but not accuracy, and dropping CH makes the cohort easier without improving the model. See RESULTS.md.
